content_of_post_to_comment: The bank ATM can never read my grandma’s checks. Apparently her cursive is too cursive-y to be read by a computer. So I have a new theory. In twenty years when AI has taken over, we in the underground will use cursive to communicate. Write in cursive. Confuse AI.
comment: Funny how the things machines struggle with often preserve human quirks. Maybe the future isn't humans vs AI, but a strange partnership where our imperfections become a kind of encryption.
